source: persisted REVE public-web national sweep + official/public CPO research

decisions.label: Ajuntament de Corçà
decisions.reason: Official municipal energy-transition pages were located, but no current public numeric EV-charging tariff was found in first pass.

decisions.label: AJUNTAMENT DE COSTITX
decisions.reason: Municipal charging point is evidenced; March 2024 reporting states Costitx was still not charging users, but no durable 2026 municipal tariff/free-service authority was found, so the 2024 condition is not extrapolated.

decisions.label: Ajuntament de Cunit
decisions.reason: Official February 2026 municipal source confirms eight public charging points after expansion, but does not publish a charging tariff. Parking-zone prices are not promoted as charging prices.

decisions.label: AJUNTAMENT DE EL MORELL
decisions.reason: Official municipal public-price ordinance remains published in the fiscal-ordinance portal and specifies station-level prices: Av. Camí de Reus 0.3400 EUR/kWh; Av. Catalunya 0.2900 EUR/kWh.

decisions.label: Ajuntament de Folgueroles
decisions.reason: Official municipal source confirms the charging point and that charging was temporarily free when launched in May 2023; no current 2026 numeric/free tariff authority was found, so the launch condition is not extrapolated.
